MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits my circuit projects because it can insulate soldered connections involving battery holders, wires, and relay modules I have bought.",
    "The prototype boards fit a natural next step from my breadboards and PCB supplies: making experimental circuits into soldered assemblies."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The filament assumes I use a 3D printer, while my purchases show circuit-building supplies without an established need for printing materials.",
    "The oil, inspection camera, tachometer, and thread checker would need specific maintenance or measurement tasks to be useful to me now; general workshop usefulness is not enough.",
    "Pocket-hole screws do not support my circuit work, and eighteen rolls of duct tape exceed my likely needs while providing unsuitable insulation for electrical connections."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any workshop tool or supply.",
    "Buying a thermometer and furniture casters seems to have been taken as broader demand for specialized measuring tools and hardware, although those purchases can serve separate, occasional needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated connection between breadboards, PCB supplies, jumper wires, a battery holder, and a relay matters more to me than a general resemblance to DIY equipment.",
    "I choose supplies when I can see their role in a project; owning related tools does not mean I currently need every adjacent accessory.",
    "Quantity and intended use matter: a circuit-building assortment can serve several small projects, while a bulk pack of eighteen tape rolls has no clear use for me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my electronics prototyping interests but extended them too broadly into workshop activities and supplies I have no established need for."
}
